evidence_snippets: Required roles To get the permissions that you need to set up Access Approval and approve access requests, ask your administrator to grant you the following IAM roles on your project: View and update Access Approval configuration and approve access requests: Access Approval Config Editor ( roles/accessapproval.configEditor ) View Access Approval configuration and approve access requests: Access Approval Approver ( roles/accessapproval.approver ) View Access Approval configuration and access requests and download log reports: Access Approval Viewer ( roles/accessapproval.viewer ) For more information about granting roles, see Manage access to projects, folders, and organizations .

Add yourself as an approver for Access Approval requests and configure notifications To add yourself as an approver so you can review and approve access requests, do the following: Go to the Access Approval page in the Google Cloud console.

After you approve the request, Google personnel with characteristics matching the approval, such as the same justification, location, or desk location, can access the specified resource and its child resources within the approved timeframe.
